title: Camp Bagong Diwa starts allowing family visits for detained protesters

blocks.text: Police on Monday afternoon began allowing some relatives of protesters arrested in Muntinlupa City to visit them at Camp Bagong Diwa, a day after they were brought to the National Capital Region Police Office (NCRPO) headquarters.
